# Two kinds of competence record

A tick beside attendance says a person was present; it does not say which tasks they can do with support. Supported practice could record a demonstrated task and the person available for the next attempt. Avoid building a surveillance sheet that follows volunteers forever. [[Field methods]]: collect information for a named decision, and delete it when that decision is finished.
